answers.explanation: Simplex: one sender, one or more listeners.
They take turns, like walkie-talkie users saying "over".
With no return path, the sender never hears "got it".
One to transmit and one to receive.
Both people can talk and hear at the same time.
One path, and the receiving end needs no transmitter.
That's why half-duplex media need rules like CSMA/CD from chapter 3.
Two paths, both directions at once.
